routes.population: All advertised since-based pages of the public organization directory, optionally after the selected numeric ID.

routes.name: authenticated

arguments.name: authenticated_user
arguments.description: Select the authenticated personal account using GitHub /user endpoints; never infer the account from ambient login names.

routes.population: Credential-authorized organizations returned by /user/orgs. Fine-grained tokens may return an empty list by API contract; this does not prove absence of memberships.

routes.name: repository_owners

arguments.name: owner
arguments.description: GitHub organization or user owner; user listings contain public owned repositories only. Mutually exclusive with repository and organization.

arguments.name: repository
arguments.description: One repository as owner/name. Mutually exclusive with owner and organization.

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

routes.population: Distinct organization owners of selected repositories; personal owners produce no organization.

functions.name: organization_memberships
functions.description: Organization/user membership pairs. Organization scope follows credential visibility; user scope enumerates public memberships only. Membership-object routes preserve active versus pending state and role. Enterprise team slugs are an observed list capped at 100 by GitHub, not a complete enterprise membership inventory. Summary endpoints establish active state but do not expose membership-object detail; those detail columns remain NULL.

metrics.name: organization_member_count
metrics.comment: Active visible organization/account relationships. Pending invitations are retained as membership records but excluded from this active member count.

metrics.name: organization_membership_record_count
metrics.comment: Selected active or pending organization membership records at organization/account grain.

metrics.name: pending_organization_membership_count
metrics.comment: Selected organization memberships still pending acceptance; not active organization members.

routes.name: public_members

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

arguments.name: organization_public_members
arguments.description: Select only publicly declared organization memberships; private membership is outside this retrieval population.

routes.population: Active publicly declared organization memberships; private memberships are outside this population.

routes.name: lookup

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

arguments.name: membership_user
arguments.description: Account login whose organization membership or membership-check observation is selected.

routes.population: Visible membership object records retaining active or pending state. Exact missing affiliation and permission failures propagate.

routes.name: authenticated

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

arguments.name: authenticated_user
arguments.description: Select the authenticated personal account using GitHub /user endpoints; never infer the account from ambient login names.

arguments.name: organization_membership_state
arguments.description: Optional authenticated membership state filter. Pending means an invitation has not been accepted; active member counts exclude pending rows.

routes.population: Authenticated account membership records across all organizations or one explicit organization. Optional state filters apply to the selected rows; pending records are retained but not counted as active members. Missing exact affiliation and permission errors fail.

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

routes.name: members

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: One personal GitHub user login, including work in repositories owned by other accounts.

routes.population: Public memberships of selected users. This reverse endpoint excludes private memberships, even with authentication.

functions.name: teams
functions.description: Canonical teams selected by organization, one team slug, or repository access. Numeric, authenticated-account and immediate-child retrieval routes share stable team identity. Full-team-only fields remain NULL on summary routes; pinned numeric routes are deprecated upstream.

metrics.name: team_count
metrics.comment: Current visible team identities in the selected organization, including empty teams.

routes.name: invitations

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

arguments.name: organization_invitation_id
arguments.description: Exact organization invitation identity used to retrieve its associated teams.

routes.population: Teams associated with one invitation, hydrated to canonical team identity.

routes.name: numeric_identity

arguments.name: team_numeric_id
arguments.description: Exact stable team identity through pinned legacy numeric routes; GitHub marks these routes as closing down. Prefer organization plus team_slug where available.

routes.population: One exact team by stable numeric identity through the pinned deprecated endpoint.

routes.name: authenticated

arguments.name: authenticated_user
arguments.description: Select the authenticated personal account using GitHub /user endpoints; never infer the account from ambient login names.

routes.population: All advertised pages of teams available to the authenticated account; fine-grained token ownership limits the visible organizations.

arguments.name: parent_team_slug
arguments.description: Select immediate child teams of this team slug; requires organization. This does not recursively enumerate descendants.

routes.population: Immediate child teams only; each child hydrates to its canonical stable identity.

routes.name: children_numeric

arguments.name: parent_team_numeric_id
arguments.description: Select immediate child teams of this stable parent team ID through the pinned legacy route.

routes.population: Immediate child teams only; each child hydrates to its canonical stable identity.

arguments.name: owner

arguments.name: repository

arguments.name: organization

routes.population: Distinct teams with access to the selected organization-owned repositories; requires permission to enumerate repository teams.

functions.name: team_memberships
functions.description: Effective membership returned for each visible team. One person in two teams contributes two memberships. Child-team membership may be included by GitHub; optional role and inherited fields remain NULL when absent. Exact object routes retain pending state. Active member lists do not expose membership-object URLs; object routes do not expose inherited status, which remains NULL.

metrics.name: team_membership_count
metrics.comment: Active effective team/account relationships, including inherited members; pending invitations are excluded.

metrics.name: team_membership_record_count
metrics.comment: Selected active and pending team/account membership records.

metrics.name: pending_team_membership_count
metrics.comment: Selected pending team membership records, excluding active effective members.

arguments.name: team_slug

routes.population: Exact visible team/account membership with active or pending state; missingmembership404 fails.
